output_priority.name: Preferred power source
output_priority.description: SUB: solar, then grid, then battery. SBU: solar, then battery, then grid. Switching to SUB started charging in this setup with SNU selected. Source preference does not independently enable or disable charging. Code 02 remains unidentified.
output_priority.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.

charger_priority.name: Allowed charging sources
charger_priority.description: SNU permits both solar and grid charging. Other stored codes can be selected but their label mapping on this firmware is unconfirmed. This differs from the source powering AC loads.
charger_priority.meaning_confidence: Confirmed for SNU; other codes unknown
charger_priority.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.

utility_charge_current.name: Grid-to-battery charge limit (DC)
utility_charge_current.description: Maximum battery-side DC amps supplied by the grid charger. It counts toward the total charge limit in program 02. A lower total limit takes precedence. This is not AC amps drawn from the breaker.
utility_charge_current.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.

total_charge_current.name: Total battery charge limit (DC)
total_charge_current.description: Maximum combined solar and grid charging current at the battery, in DC amps. This does not include AC load current or set emergency battery-output power. Both charge selectors retain the 30 A DC site ceiling.
total_charge_current.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.

back_to_grid_voltage.name: Use grid below battery voltage
back_to_grid_voltage.description: Low battery voltage threshold for transferring loads to available grid power in SBU mode. Battery/BMS mode can affect whether voltage or SOC thresholds apply.
back_to_grid_voltage.meaning_confidence: High confidence: manual; transfer behavior not commissioned
back_to_grid_voltage.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.

back_to_battery_voltage.name: Resume battery above voltage
back_to_battery_voltage.description: Recovery battery voltage threshold for returning loads to battery preference in SBU mode. This is not a charge-voltage target. BMS mode may change applicability.
back_to_battery_voltage.meaning_confidence: High confidence: manual; transfer behavior not commissioned
back_to_battery_voltage.verification_scope: Consult verified_values for tested stored values; readback alone does not verify physical behavior.
